title: Quietly Quenched Kenyan Chicken Stew
description: A fresh and tender Kenyan dish featuring almond milk, perfect for a special occasion. This low-sodium stew is cooked in an earthenware bowl to bring out the unique flavors.
instructions: Heat the earthenware bowl over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken breast pieces and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Add the tomato paste, cumin, turmeric, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Pour in the almond milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the stew cook for 20 minutes.
Stir the stew occasionally to prevent the chicken from sticking to the bowl.
Use a whisk to stir the stew and create a smooth sauce.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
